season.short_description: Flu season of the estimate, written as 2024-25.
season.long_description: Season the cumulative estimate belongs to. Flu seasons run July through June.

vaccine.short_description: Flu (seasonal influenza vaccine) or rsv (RSV vaccine).
vaccine.long_description: Vaccine the estimate refers to. For flu, seasonal influenza vaccine received this season, from NIS-Flu (children) and NIS-FRVM (adults). For rsv, RSV vaccine ever received, from NIS-FRVM (adults 75+ and adults 50-74 with high-risk conditions).

population.short_description: Group the survey covers: children 6 months-17 years, adults 18+, adults 75+, or adults 50-74 at high risk.
population.long_description: Population the estimate describes. Children and adults 18 and older are asked about flu vaccine. Adults 75 and older and adults 50-74 at high risk of severe RSV are asked about RSV vaccine.

age.long_name: Age group within the survey population
age.short_description: Age group within the survey population, using CDC's labels.
age.long_description: Age group of the national estimate in data_age.csv.gz. Labels changed slightly between seasons and are kept as published.

stratum_type.long_name: Demographic dimension of the national estimate
stratum_type.short_description: Demographic dimension of the national estimate, such as sex, race and ethnicity, or poverty status.
stratum_type.long_description: Dimension the national estimate in data_demographics.csv.gz is broken down by. The dimensions available differ between the child and adult surveys.

stratum.short_description: Group within the demographic dimension, using CDC's labels.
stratum.long_description: Group within stratum_type, as labelled by CDC.

geography_name.long_name: CDC name of the non-FIPS area
geography_name.short_description: CDC's name for the HHS region, sub-state area, or local area.
geography_name.long_description: CDC's name for the area in data_region.csv.gz and data_substate.csv.gz. The geography column in those files is not a FIPS code.

geography_level.short_description: Type of area: Substate or Local.
geography_level.long_description: Substate is CDC's split of a large state into a city and the rest of the state. Local is a city or county published on its own in the 2019-20 to 2022-23 seasons.

state_fips.long_name: FIPS code of the state containing the area
state_fips.short_description: FIPS code of the state that contains the area.
state_fips.long_description: Two-digit FIPS code of the state that contains the sub-state or local area.

nis_coverage.short_description: Percent of the population vaccinated as of the week ending date.
nis_coverage.long_description: Survey estimate of the cumulative percent who received a flu vaccine this season, or an RSV vaccine at any time, as of the week ending date. CDC suppresses estimates with a cumulative sample under 30 or a current-week sample under 5.
nis_coverage.statement: In {location}, {value}% had received the vaccine as of {time}

nis_coverage_lcl.long_name: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage
nis_coverage_lcl.short_description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage.
nis_coverage_lcl.long_description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage.

nis_coverage_ucl.long_name: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage
nis_coverage_ucl.short_description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage.
nis_coverage_ucl.long_description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage.

nis_intent_definitely.long_name: Percent unvaccinated who definitely plan to get the vaccine
nis_intent_definitely.short_description: Percent not yet vaccinated who say they definitely will get the vaccine.
nis_intent_definitely.long_description: Percent of the population who had not received the vaccine and said they definitely will get it. Available from the 2023-24 season.

nis_intent_probably.long_name: Percent unvaccinated who probably will get the vaccine or are unsure
nis_intent_probably.short_description: Percent not yet vaccinated who say they probably will get the vaccine or are unsure.
nis_intent_probably.long_description: Percent of the population who had not received the vaccine and said they probably will get it or were unsure. Available from the 2023-24 season.

nis_intent_no.long_name: Percent unvaccinated who definitely or probably will not get the vaccine
nis_intent_no.short_description: Percent not yet vaccinated who say they will not get the vaccine.
nis_intent_no.long_description: Percent of the population who had not received the vaccine and said they definitely or probably will not get it. Available from the 2023-24 season.

nis_sample_size.short_description: Number of survey respondents contributing to the estimate.
nis_sample_size.long_description: Unweighted number of respondents in the season to date for the geography and group.

suppressed_flag.short_description: 1 if CDC suppressed the estimate because of a small sample, 0 otherwise.
suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 if CDC suppressed the estimate because the cumulative sample was under 30 or the current-week sample was under 5, 0 otherwise. Suppressed values are missing.

nis_flu.name: National Immunization Survey-Flu (NIS-Flu)
nis_flu.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
nis_flu.location: Weekly Influenza Vaccination Status and Intent for Vaccination, Children 6 Months-17 Years (FluVaxView dashboard)
nis_flu.description: The National Immunization Survey-Flu (NIS-Flu) is a national random-digit-dialed cellular telephone survey of households with children 6 months-17 years, conducted by CDC from October through June each flu season. A parent or guardian who knows the child's vaccination history reports whether and when the child received a flu vaccine. Estimates are weighted to the population of each state and the nation. CDC publishes weekly cumulative coverage and, since the 2023-24 season, parental intent to vaccinate, for the nation, HHS regions, states, and selected local areas. Estimates are preliminary and may differ from CDC's final estimates for the season. Parent-reported vaccination tends to run higher than coverage measured from immunization registries.
nis_flu.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

nis_frvm.name: National Immunization Survey-Fall Respiratory Virus Module (NIS-FRVM)
nis_frvm.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
nis_frvm.location: Weekly Influenza and RSV Vaccination Coverage and Intent, Adults 18 Years and Older (FluVaxView and RSVVaxView dashboards)
nis_frvm.description: The National Immunization Survey-Fall Respiratory Virus Module (NIS-FRVM), formerly the NIS-Adult COVID Module, is an ongoing random-digit-dialed cellular telephone survey of adults 18 and older conducted by CDC. Respondents report their own flu, COVID-19, and RSV vaccination, and estimates are weighted to the U.S. population. CDC publishes weekly cumulative flu coverage and intent to vaccinate for the nation, HHS regions, and states from the 2021-22 season, and RSV coverage and intent for adults 75 and older and adults 50-74 at high risk for the nation and HHS regions. Data collection for the 2025-26 season ended on February 21, 2026. Self-reported vaccination tends to run higher than coverage measured from immunization registries.
nis_frvm.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

_catalog.name: NIS-Flu and NIS-FRVM weekly flu and RSV vaccination
_catalog.summary: CDC's National Immunization Surveys track each week how many children and adults have had a flu vaccine and how many older adults have had an RSV vaccine, by state.
